title: Workflow Optimization and Model Routing Upgrade V2
businessObjective: Optimize master delivery workflow by moving from 7 PRs to 2 PRs per feature, implementing a Declarative Validator Registry, post-merge bot reconciliation, and optimizing agent model routing & effort tiers.
technicalObjective: Implement Task Packet V2 schema (schemas/task-packet-v2.schema.json), SHA-bound review schema (schemas/review-result-v1.schema.json), validator registry schema & runner (schemas/validator-registry-v1.schema.json, policies/validator-registry-v1.json, scripts/verify/run-validator-registry.mjs), migration parity test (tests/governance/validate-validator-registry-migration.mjs), launcher context profiles & pre-execution fallbacks (scripts/codex/launch.mjs), and CI reconciliation job.
assumptions: SUT-AIOS-GOV-056 executes under the existing V1 task workflow one final time.
Task Packet V1 terminal done records remain 100% untouched and valid.
All new feature tasks following GOV-056 will use Task Packet V2 (schemaVersion 2.0.0) and the two-PR workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: `schemas/task-packet-v2.schema.json` defines Draft 2020-12 schemaVersion 2.0.0 with stage-specific `routingPolicy` object as the single routing authority; task tools validate both V1 and V2 packets.

`schemas/review-result-v1.schema.json` defines Draft 2020-12 review schema bound to `taskId`, `baseSha`, `headSha`, `contextManifestHash`, `reviewedAt`, `outputHash`, `decision`, `blockingFindings`, `nonBlockingRisks`, `missingNegativeTests`, `architectureAssessment`, and `exactNextAction`.
`schemas/validator-registry-v1.schema.json` and `policies/validator-registry-v1.json` establish typed active validator declarations.
`scripts/verify/run-validator-registry.mjs` executes active validators shell-free under `tests/` with `process.execPath`, traversal/symlink rejection, timeout enforcement, and deterministic sorting.
`tests/governance/validate-validator-registry-migration.mjs` proves 100% parity with current hardcoded CI validator lists before hardcoded lists are refactored.

`scripts/codex/launch.mjs` extracts stage-specific `routingPolicy`, enforces agent `allowed_model_routes` / `allowed_reasoning_efforts`, restricts automatic fallback to provable pre-execution process start errors, implements generic context profiles, and validates review output against `review-result-v1.schema.json`.

`.github/workflows/validate-governance.yml` runs `run-validator-registry.mjs` in `validate` job and adds dependent `reconciliation` job running post-push on `main` to move verified packets to `done` idempotently.

`agents/command/chief-orchestrator.md`, `engineering-planner.md`, `codex-engineering-executor.md`, `qa-verification.md`, `REGISTRY.md`, `ROUTING.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `TASK_WORKFLOW.md`, `DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md`, `ENGINEERING_PRINCIPLES.md`, `AUTONOMY_BOUNDARIES.md` are updated with the 2-PR delivery flow, effort tiers, and model diversity rules.
All fast verification, task validation, governance validation, and parity tests pass with zero errors.
requiredChecks: Task Packet V2 schema validation and backward compatibility with V1
Validator Registry V1 migration parity test pass
SHA-bound review result schema compilation and validation
Launcher generic context profiles and pre-execution fallback verification
Fast verification and governance validation pass
solEscalationTriggers: Escalate to Sol if schema compilation or launcher routing fails.
